name: 08-continue-nudge
description: type = 'continue' with continue_prefill OFF, so populateChatHistory takes its nudge branch (openai.js:907-927): the last non-injected message is spliced out of the list, re-prepared, put into the continueNudge collection in front of the nudge prompt itself, and that collection is appended at position -1 -- the very tail of the completion (openai.js:1088-1090). dialogueExamples sits at index 1, i.e. *before* the push position, because the collections are placed by slot assignment (openai.js:4002-4006) and a later `add(..., index)` overwrites whatever holds that slot: with dialogueExamples after chatHistory in this list the nudge would be silently replaced by it.
